premises.text: Priorities are not only emails; email clients and task managers alone cannot solve priority management because capture, triage, plan, and do must work together as the Handle habit
premises.evidence_span: email clients have not been able to solve this problem alone, and task managers have not been able to solve this problem alone

premises.text: Handle is a priority engine that captures thoughts/tasks/emails from mobile and inbox, triages via handlebar keyboard commands, plans an importance-ordered must-do list with calendar blocking, and executes with full task context
premises.evidence_span: Introducing the world's first priority engine, Handle

domains.name: email and tasks fail priority alone

value.text: People get their must-do work done that day so they can do what they feel is most important, including family dinner without phone-checking
value.evidence_span: getting all the must do things you have to do done that day

secondary_value.text: Keep yourself in shape and reclaim life beyond Handle-the-product
secondary_value.evidence_span: The disruption is keeping yourself in shape

causal_links.evidence_span: Priorities are not all emails, and emails are not all priorities
I finished all my important work for the day

notes: Capture/triage/plan/do stated as one indivisible Handle habit; mobile capture, handlebar commands, priority list, and do-context demo folded as product cascade of that engine (§4.1.7). Outcome claims kept in value/secondary_value, not as premises (§3.5). Menlo/Siri bio detail excluded. Two-domain partition.
